## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the refresh operation before merge because it can make verification pass after a tracked file was edited by hand.

## Changes

The pull request adds two helpers for updating the fingerprint manifest and tests for their behavior. `refresh_fingerprints` writes a digest for every supplied path, while `register_new_files` adds digests only for unlisted paths.

## Critical

- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve tracked fingerprints during refresh — When you refresh a hand-edited `tracked.txt` alongside a new `new.txt`, the refresh replaces the original digest for `tracked.txt` with the digest of its edited contents. `verify` then compares the file against that replacement. — After refreshing a list that includes an edited tracked file, users lose the ability to detect that edit through verification. — Fix: Reuse the existing-entry guard in `register_new_files` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries`.
